comments.body:
The headliner for Glamsterdam will be decided soon. It will be followed by discussions on other EIPs for Glamsterdam. Some may argue that censorship resistance can be postponed because the current censorship situation has improved. However, we should remember that this improvement relies solely on top builders choosing not to censor. Ethereum remains vulnerable to censorship, which can be swayed by the decisions of a few. Ethereum deserves robust censorship resistance integrated into the protocol.

### Research

**FOCIL and ePBS**

With ePBS spec is being updated, the compatibility between ePBS and FOCIL is also revisited. We have a new [article](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/epbs-focil-compatibility/24777) that provides the up-to-date ideas about the compatibility. It uses the IL bitlist to indicate which ILs a builder considered when building a block. The IL bitlist inclusivity check can be done by attesters or PTC, depending on the trade-offs. The attesters approach can leverage the whole beacon committee but would reorg a beacon block when it fails the inclusivity check. The PTC approach would reorg a payload, which gives us better liveness, but it relies on PTC, a small set of validators.

For more details, please take a look into the [article](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/epbs-focil-compatibility/24777) and tune in for next breakout call. In the next breakout, Thomas will give us a presentation and Potuz would join us to provide feedback.

### Development

Since the previous breakout, there was a [discussion](https://hackmd.io/@jihoonsong/S1c2dhMrle) on the CL spec. Thanks to valuable feedback thus far, now the [CL spec revamp PR](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4351) has been updated.

Q: Is FOCIL compatible with shorter slot time?
A: It depends on slot time. If the slot time is 1 second, we would need to consider another design, which also applies to other EIPs. With a 6 second slot time, there would be no problem.

**FOCIL Metrics**

* [Katya](https://x.com/Sib_Katya) will publish the draft FOCIL beacon metrics soon. Having these metrics will allow us to easily run benchmarks. The metrics dashboard will be accessible through Kurtosis.
